newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai, Hong Kong said to benefit from handover.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai, Hong Kong said to benefit from handover.

text.p: Shanghai's official media on Tuesday welcomed Hong Kong back to the motherland, saying both cities were "shining pearls" on the China coast that would equally benefit from the former colony's return to Chinese control.
The Liberation Daily published comments from Shanghai's Communist Party chief Huang Ju saying the two cities would join hands and move forward to the benefit of both and of China as a whole.
"Shanghai and Hong Kong are both shining pearls on the Pacific Ocean coast," Huang said.
"The two will definitely see mutual benefit and joint prosperity."
He said the return of Hong Kong to Chinese control was a joyous and exciting event.
"In future years, Shanghai and Hong Kong will join hands to move forward and make new contributions to revitalize China," Huang added.

Shanghai, once a thriving capitalist enclave itself taken over by the communists in 1949, is now aiming to resume its role as a major east Asian financial centre, a position usurped by upstart Hong Kong in recent decades.
